subject: What AI helpers will ask you to hand over
headline: Every AI company wants to run your life. What will each one ask you to hand over?

files.name: 1-what-the-reviews-say.png
files.purpose: One person says a shop charged them $6,000 for clothes that cost about $1,500. Muse wrote to the shop to get the money back.

files.name: 2-five-bets.png
files.purpose: Each one is betting on a different part of you. Meta wants your personal life, OpenAI wants your work, Google wants the life in your Gmail, Anthropic the careful helper at work, Apple the private one.

files.name: 3-how-good-are-they.png
files.purpose: How good are they? A CNN reporter found that ChatGPT and Google's Gemini can do similar jobs to Muse.

files.name: 4-three-places.png
files.purpose: Your own phone. The company's computers. Or a locked box on the company's computers that even the company can't open.

files.name: 5-the-ads.png
files.purpose: And the ads? Meta makes nearly all its money from ads. Of course it'll sell what its helper suggests.

files.name: 6-my-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction: by 30 June 2027 OpenAI, Google or Anthropic will have a helper that shops for you, in a locked box the company can't open. 55%.
